decisions.statement: A name listed in the game's HUD fragment group belongs to every HUD scene.
A fragment one scene adds by itself belongs to that scene alone.
A control named beside a hide method is catalogued under that method.
A call sitting under a nearby condition is marked conditional.
One ESO global found twice is merged into one record.
A global found under two kinds refuses the reading rather than being guessed at.
The fragments come before the controls.

definition: the HUD parts read out of the game's own scene source
